validation_scope: Existing build-time geometry checks and workflow output-presence checks; revised joint geometry awaits regenerated-output validation and physical print-fit test

joint.type: radial slide-in rounded tapered key tongue/socket

known_limitations: CAD validity checks apply to in-memory CadQuery shapes before export.
GitHub Actions verified generated files exist and are non-empty; it did not re-import the exported STEP files.
Propellers remain separate components; the arm modules each contain one connected solid comprising arm, guard and motor.
The revised rounded/tapered joint geometry must be regenerated and checked by GitHub Actions before its exported files are treated as current.
No locking fastener is currently included; the joint is not yet verified against pull-out or flight loads.
Physical insertion force and printer-dependent fit have not been tested; print a small joint coupon before printing the complete parts.
